changelog: First public release of fx-admin — modern, themed, optimized admin panel for QBCore, Qbox and ESX.

New Gang Management page: the full Job Management toolset - bulk and per-selection removal, transfer to another gang, grade reset, single and bulk CK with backup and restore, member list with online/offline filter, search and CSV export - now works on gangs too. Jobs and gangs are two separate pages under the Jobs & Gangs nav group.

Jobs and gangs share ONE code path instead of duplicated code. Every layer (framework, database, business logic, UI) takes a kind parameter that is either job or gang, so a later fix lands on both sides at once. Omitting it means job, so nothing that called these functions before had to change.

Gang operations write to players.gang through SetGang using the gang JSON schema (no payment/onduty fields). Counts, personnel queries and the reset/transfer UPDATEs all pick their column from the category, and the count cache is now per category - one shared cache would have let gang counts overwrite job counts.

Discord logs are category-aware. Gang operations can go to their own Config.GangLogsWebhook and fall back to JobLogsWebhook then LogsWebhook. Embed title, field names (Old Gang / New Gang) and footer follow the category, and CK records from this page are tagged gangck so CK History and the restore log label them correctly.

Recent Actions is filtered per category: the job page no longer shows gang operations and vice versa. Entries written before this release carry no category field and are treated as job, so existing history stays intact.

New config keys: Config.JobManagement.GangResetTarget (default "none") is the gang a removed member is moved to, and Config.GangLogsWebhook (empty = falls back to the job webhook). Config.JobManagement.HistoryLimit is shared between job and gang history - raise it if both sides are used heavily.
ESX has no gang concept, so the Gang Management page stays empty there and every gang operation is rejected with a nogang error instead of silently touching the player job.
Fixed: the jobmgmt.hard_grade_desc locale string was cut off mid-sentence in both tr and en, so the final grade-reset confirmation showed half a sentence.

Ambulance / death-system bridge: revive and full heal now go through whichever medical script the server runs, instead of only restoring health on the ped. Wasabi Advanced Ambulance is supported in both v1 and v2 (folder named wasabi_ambulance, wasabi_ambulance_v2 or wasabi_ambulancev2), alongside the existing qb-ambulancejob, Renewed-Ambulance and esx_ambulancejob.

Fixed: on servers running Wasabi, revive reported success and did nothing. The panel, the /revive keybind and the Discord /revive and /revive-all commands all restored health while Wasabi kept its own death state, so the player stayed down and was told they had been revived. Wasabi revives from the server through an export, not from the client, so the whole flow was moved server side.

Fixed: full heal left Wasabi players capped and still bleeding. Wasabi derives max health from limb damage and keeps injuries server side, so healing the ped alone could not clear them. Heal now clears injuries and limb health through the script, and no longer writes health from the client where Wasabi owns that value.
New config key: Config.Ambulance (default auto) pins the medical script - auto, wasabi, qb, renewed, esx or none.

Fixed: CK History could not find older records. The list only ever carried the newest 200 rows and the search box filtered those rows in the browser, so a CK outside that window read as 'not found' in the panel even though the backup was still in the database and still restorable. Search and the status tabs now run as SQL on the server, so every record is reachable regardless of the list window.

CK History search accepts Discord ID, Steam hex and license as well as name, citizenid, job and the admin who performed the CK. The backup table stores only citizenid and license, so a Discord ID or Steam hex is resolved through the identifier ledger first - the Discord lookup also scans online players, so an account never written to the ledger is still found.

Fixed: the counters above CK History showed the list length instead of the real totals, so Total CK Records sat pinned at the 200 ceiling and told the admin that was all of them. They are now counted across the whole table.

CK History selection survives a new search. The restore basket keeps the record itself, not just its id, so selecting one character and then searching for another no longer drops the first from the basket.
